subject: Delegate or commit: 15m demo window
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir@apertureio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Delegate or commit: 15m demo window

Hi Samir — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps: we covered your latency-sensitive inference use case, current throughput expectations (~300 TPS during peak), and two questions around on-prem networking and KMS. Your engineering lead mentioned this is a high-priority pilot for Q1.

To keep momentum I want to lock a 15-minute technical demo (low-level runthrough + integration checklist). Two options from our side:
- Option A: Tue 2026-11-16 09:30–09:45 PT
- Option B: Wed 2026-11-17 11:00–11:15 PT

If neither works, please either: 1) confirm a different single 15-minute slot (we’ll try to accommodate), or 2) delegate an owner who can accept on your calendar and own the technical questions. If you confirm, we’ll send the calendar invite with a short pre-read.

Attachments: preliminary MVP requirements (aperture_mvp_requirements_v1.pdf) and our integration checklist link below.

Thanks — Moni
Monica Patel
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0182

Monica — sorry I had to hop onto an exec escalation mid-call and missed the last 10 minutes. Appreciate the recap.

We definitely want to proceed; the right owner for the technical deep dive is our Ops lead, Neha (cc'd on ops@apertureio.com). I can't confirm Tue 16th at 09:30 PT — that's blocked for me. Wed 17th 11:00 PT should work for our side if Neha (ops) can confirm.

If Neha can't make it, please propose a fallback on Thu 11/18 08:00–08:15 PT or Thu 11/18 16:00–16:15 PT and we'll prioritize one. Keep it tight — we only need the integration checklist and a short demo of the KV cache behavior.

Thanks,
Samir

Thanks Samir — copying Monica. Wed 11/17 11:00 PT works for our engineering lead on a short call. Karthik (cc'ed by Monica) can run the demo; he'll focus on sequence-length behavior and KV cache warmup which maps to the questions you raised.

Samir — if Neha from ops can confirm, we'll lock it. If not, please pick one of the Thu slots Samir suggested (08:00 PT or 16:00 PT) and indicate preference. Want to avoid multiple back-and-forths so if you prefer, delegate to Neha to accept and we'll treat that as confirmation.

—Marissa

Samir / Ops — following up to finalize: Karthik is ready to run Wed 11/17 11:00–11:15 PT. If Neha (ops) or another owner can accept the invite by EOD tomorrow (2026-11-11), we'll send the calendar hold and include the pre-read. If we don't get confirmation by EOD 11/11 we'll shift to Thu 11/18 16:00 PT and mark that as tentative for your team — please reply with the one slot you prefer or have someone accept.

- Aperture: accept the Wed slot or reply with which single fallback slot you prefer (Thu 08:00 PT or Thu 16:00 PT). If you want, delegate to Neha to accept on your behalf.
- Redwood: Karthik will prepare the 5-slide pre-read and a short runbook; Marissa will send the invite once Aperture confirms.
